name: Auriferous-Tor
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an ancient meteor crater, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Approach protocols for the quarantine zone are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
